title: Greek Yogurt Protein Bowl
subtitle: 3-min breakfast. Whey-boosted, berries on top.

ingredients.thai_market_tip: FAGE or Gaia at Tops. The proper strained kind — not the 'Greek-style' Thai brands which are runnier.
Mr Hyde, Optimum Nutrition, or Bulk at the supplement aisle / iHerb. 1 scoop = ~25g.
Tops frozen aisle — Wyman's or any 'mixed berries' bag. Frozen wins on price + macros.
Tops health aisle or Lemon Farm. Standard.

ingredients.note: Skip if cutting sugar — whey isolate is already sweet.

substitutions.note: Thicker, more pudding-like. Same macros. Good for slow-digest before-bed snack.
More carbs / less fibre / more sugar. Better post-workout for refuelling.
Cuts fat hard. Tops carries PB2 in the health section.

steps.text: Tip yogurt into a bowl. Sprinkle whey on top.
Stir whey in slowly. Goes from runny to thick-mousse in 20 sec — don't overmix or it'll seize.
Top with frozen berries (still frozen — they'll thaw into the yogurt as you eat).
Shower chopped almonds, chia seeds, optional honey, cinnamon.

notes: The 3-minute, no-cook, 55g protein breakfast. Whey + Greek yogurt is the highest-density protein move that doesn't taste like a protein shake. Add berries FROZEN — they release moisture into the yogurt as they thaw and you get cold + creamy + tart, all from one move.
